current_suppliers.provides: Actual pristine WeakRef constructor/deref captured before extension input, explicit end-of-job kept-target lifecycle, and existing private intrinsic registry lifetime.

Pristine Map constructor, Map.entries iterator method, Map.set and iterator.next already captured before guest code. Missing Map.get/delete/size getter, FinalizationRegistry constructor/register and Array.prototype.forEach for this class.
Actual VM WeakRef kept-object checkpoint and private-symbol/private-property Set API already exist.
Existing source controls exercise actual private-slot creation, own-descriptor access, proxy/nonextensible cases and retirement; no runtime result is transferred.
Current stable native invocation and pending/retirement semantics for private native callbacks.
Actual private callable closures with owned captured JS roots and native dispatch.

compile_info_prerequisite.scope: Actual function/script plus lexer metadata owner is source accepted; it does not provide maybeCacheSourceMap.

concrete_next_slice.owner: Original SourceMapCacheMap class, as a private native owner with actual JavaScript Map/WeakRef/FinalizationRegistry objects.
proposed_targets: src/extensions/native_clone_intrinsics.zig (narrow pristine captures and shared private key)
constructor_inputs: Actual Engine and its pre-guest pristine intrinsic registry.
One source_map_data_private_symbol per Engine/runtime, shared by every cache instance.
Actual native callable/GC-marked owner for cleanup and iterator closures; genuine registry register operation.
concrete_next_slice.no_policy_dependencies: This cache class stores already-produced entry data. It does not choose source-map enablement, URLs, files, modules or ESM behavior.
semantics: Create a real WeakRef to moduleInstance; alias every supplied key to that WeakRef, attach data to the shared private module slot, then register the real FinalizationRegistry holding keys. Preserve this exact order and partial effects if a later operation fails.
Own only keys, WeakRefs and registry state in the cache. Entry data stays on the actual module, permitting eager reclamation; do not substitute a strong key-to-data map.
Cleanup examines the currently mapped WeakRef before deletion. A stale finalization notification must not delete a newer live replacement.
get returns the current module private slot after genuine deref. Multiple cache instances share the private key, as the per-isolate original does.
size reports the actual map's estimate including obsolete keys until cleanup. Iteration preserves live Map iterator behavior, skips reclaimed modules and reads their current private slot.
Capture all used intrinsic operations before guest input and retain native closure/registry state across reentry and retirement.
meaningful_controls: Alias keys share actual module-backed data; replacing a shared module slot is visible across cache instances.
WeakRef target is retained until the actual job checkpoint, then reclaimable without the cache retaining source-map data.
Old cleanup cannot delete a newer live replacement at the same key.
Iteration skips reclaimed targets, preserves insertion/replacement behavior and returns its own iterator identity.
Tampered global/prototype methods cannot redirect captured pristine operations.
Key-array getter/holes and partial-set effects preserve original Array.prototype.forEach ordering.
Private data remains non-enumerable and does not leak through ordinary symbol enumeration; proxy/nonextensible semantics use the existing actual private-slot API.
Actual pending/fatal producer and finalizer reentry preserve first-fatal identity while retiring partially created WeakRefs/registry/iterator roots.

required_following_startup_work: maybeCacheSourceMap still needs actual process.env.NODE_V8_COVERAGE and sourceMapsSupport ownership; defaulting it to an unconditional no-op would omit original observable decisions.

Native URL/path normalization and data/file URL handling, Buffer base64 decode and actual readFileSync/JSON parse must feed a real entry before this cache can serve wrapSafe. The original keeps null data entries for invalid maps and coverage.
Source-map support toggling must update the actual native error/stack-trace owner, then publish the frozen support record in the original order.
Canonical Module assembly still requires real wrap_module_load/debugWithTimer/tracingChannel suppliers and the remaining inspector/TS/ESM dependencies already recorded.
later_full_surface: SourceMap V3 decoding/findSourceMap and mapped stack presentation are later full source-map surfaces; this assessment does not claim them implemented.
Generated-source cache, coverage serialization and original-source file retrieval remain explicit consumers of actual cache state.

search_scope.note: Bounded current symbol/file and exact-path history search; not a claim that every archived differently named implementation was inspected.
